comment: Mixed review that is positive overall. B seems to have focused on the negative ending ('maddeningly predictable') while A weighed 'pleasant' and 'entertains' more.

comment: Clearly positive, but 'terribly' sounds negative out of context and 'flip' is slangy. B was fooled by the wording even though it was very confident.

text: it 's a bit disappointing that it only manages to be decent instead of dead brilliant .
comment: Negative about a film that falls short of brilliant, but it contains positive words ('decent', 'brilliant'). B latched onto those words and missed the disappointment.
Only 3 words and no sentiment words, so it is a dismissive remark that depends on tone. A guessed positive with high confidence, which is overconfident; B got it right.
